description: The AHRI Directory of Certified Product Performance is the Air-Conditioning, Heating, and Refrigeration Institute's listing of performance-certified heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration (HVACR) equipment. On its public side, engineers, contractors, regulators and consumers can search by product line, certified rating or brand; on its authenticated side manufacturers upload and manage their certified data, including details not shown publicly, and AHRI staff administer the certification programmes. AHRI's certification programmes follow ISO/IEC 17065, and only products that pass them may carry the AHRI Certified mark, as opposed to being merely rated to an AHRI standard; mutual recognition agreements exist with bodies in India, Korea and Mexico. Coverage: certified HVACR equipment from manufacturers in AHRI certification programmes. Access: free public search; AHRI also lists a directory licence for data use. Licence: AHRI terms. Caveats: the public view omits some manufacturer details, and only products in AHRI certification programmes appear. Simulation uses are rated capacities and efficiencies for sizing and modelling HVAC equipment in building energy models and retrofit studies. Related records: ENERGY STAR certified product data and the EU EPREL registry.
